newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-JOHNSON NAMED LIONS CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-JOHNSON NAMED LIONS CAPTAIN.

text.p: England lock Martin Johnson will captain the British Lions squad who depart in May for their first tour of South Africa for 17 years.
Johnson will lead the 35-man party on a 13-match tour including three tests against the Springboks on consecutive Saturdays in June and July.
The team announcement on Wednesday contained no place for former Welsh captain Jonathan Davies or South African-born Englishman Mike Catt who both had hopes of making the trip.
Instead Leicester flanker Neil Back has won a surprise inclusion as one of 17 Englishmen in the squad, with Wales filling eight places and Scotland and Ireland five apiece.
